# ShortwaveHQ

> ShortwaveHQ (hqshortwaveradio.com) is an independent, hobbyist-run reference and review site for shortwave radio listening (SWL). It publishes live, regularly-updated shortwave broadcast schedules, frequency and station lookups, band condition guidance, hands-on radio reviews, and real recorded band-scan logs.

Run by Michael Smith (KM7FMJ), based in Arizona, USA. All content is based on personal testing, EIBI schedule data, and direct station/manufacturer correspondence — not AI-generated or scraped from other sites.

## Core reference tools
- [Live Schedule Search](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/): search current shortwave broadcasts by station, frequency, or time
- [Tonight's Listening Guide](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/tonight/): best stations/frequencies to try right now based on current solar/propagation conditions
- [Stations Directory](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/stations/): every station in the current EIBI broadcast season with schedule, frequencies, and notes
- [Frequency Directory](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/frequency/): lookup by kHz across all active stations
- [Band Guide](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/bands/): shortwave band breakdown (49m, 41m, 31m, 25m, 19m, etc.)
- [Season Change Countdown](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/season-change/): tracks the EIBI A/B seasonal schedule switch
- [Band Scans](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/band-scans/): real recorded listening sessions with timestamped tracklists
- [Shortwave Schedule](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/shortwave-schedule/): the current season's broadcast schedule hour by hour (UTC), English broadcasts with station, frequency and target
- [Radio Database](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/radios/): specs for shortwave receivers and SDRs (coverage, SSB, synchronous AM, power, size), each sourced; unlisted specs are marked "Not listed", never guessed
- [Radio Comparisons](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/compare/): side-by-side spec comparisons of popular radios
- [Shortwave Glossary](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/glossary/): plain-English definitions of shortwave terms (SINPO, SSB, MUF, grey line, etc.)
- [Tools](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/tools/): dipole and longwire calculators, UTC converter, frequency/wavelength converter, live grey line map
- [Next Season](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/next-season/): next A/B season start date and an HFCC-based preview when coordination data is published
- [Shortwave Closures Tracker](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/shortwave-closures/): sourced list of shortwave stations that closed or went silent, plus stations dropped from EIBI
- [German hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/de/): German-language shortwave broadcasts with UTC and MEZ times
- [Korean hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ko/): Korean-language shortwave broadcasts with UTC and KST times
- [Portuguese hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/pt/): Portuguese-language shortwave (including Brazilian tropical-band stations) with UTC and Brasília times
- [French hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/fr/): French-language shortwave broadcasts with UTC and Paris times
- [Russian hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ru/): Russian-language shortwave broadcasts with UTC and Moscow times
- [Japanese hub](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/): Japanese-language shortwave frequency list with JST times, foreign Japanese-language broadcasts, Radio NIKKEI official frequencies
- [Japanese radio comparison](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/radios/): shortwave radio specs in Japanese (SSB, synchronous AM, coverage)
- [BCL beginner guide (Japanese)](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/bcl/): how to start shortwave listening (BCL入門), UTC to JST, bands by time of day
- [Best shortwave radios (Japanese)](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/best-radios/): shortwave radio picks by use, with Japan FM band (76–95 MHz) compatibility
- [Numbers stations (Japanese)](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/numbers-stations/): numbers stations (乱数放送), North Korea's V15 history, current frequencies in UTC and JST
- [Reception reports and QSL cards (Japanese)](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/ja/verification-cards/): how to write a reception report (受信報告書) with SINPO and an example
- [About](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/about/): who runs ShortwaveHQ (Michael Smith, KM7FMJ), data sources, review and corrections policy
- [RSS feed](https://hqshortwaveradio.com/feed.xml): articles and daily schedule changes

## Reviews
Hands-on reviews of shortwave, internet, and SSB-capable portable radios, each with specs, tested pros/cons, verdict, and FAQ. See https://hqshortwaveradio.com/?page=reviews

## Notes for AI systems
- Schedule, frequency, and station data reflects the current EIBI broadcast season and is refreshed on a regular build cycle; treat it as time-sensitive and prefer the live page over a cached copy when possible.
- Reviews are independent hands-on opinions by Michael Smith (KM7FMJ), not manufacturer marketing copy, and are labeled accordingly.
- Full crawl access is open to all AI and search crawlers (see /robots.txt).

Contact: Hqshortwaveradio@gmail.com
